faq.a: A'a. Ana faɗin jumlolin da babbar murya, ba a rubuta su, ba a naɗa su, ba a aika su ko'ina. Wasan yana nuna hotuna kawai.

faq.q: Idan wani ba ya son ya faɗi komai fa?
faq.a: Kowa na iya wucewa, kuma mutum na gaba zai ci gaba. Babu wanda ya zama dole ya sa wa hoto suna ko ya tuna shi.

faq.q: Kyauta ne, kuma ana buƙatar rajista?
faq.a: Eh, kyauta ne, kuma babu asusu, rajista ko sauke fayil. Yana aiki a burauzar yanar gizo a waya, kwamfutar hannu ko kwamfuta.

quiet-scene.name: Wurin natsuwa
quiet-scene.seoTitle: Wurin Natsuwa: Hoto Ɗaya a Lokaci
quiet-scene.h1: Wurin Natsuwa: Hoto Mai Tsayawa Ɗaya a Lokaci
quiet-scene.description: Babban hoto mai tsayawa ɗaya a lokaci, kowane da layi ɗaya mai laushi a ƙasansa. Danna Gaba ko Baya idan ka shirya. Babu abin da ke motsi ko yin wasa da kansa, kuma babu agogo ko maki. Kyauta ne, ba tare da asusu ba.
quiet-scene.short: Kalli hoto mai tsayawa ɗaya a lokaci, a gudun kanka.
quiet-scene.players: Kai kaɗai, ko rukuni a daki ɗaya
quiet-scene.intro: Babban hoto ɗaya yana cika allon, tare da gajeren layi a ƙasansa. Danna "Hoto na gaba" ko "Hoto na baya" idan ka shirya don wani. Babu abin da ke motsi, dushewa ko canzawa da kansa, kuma ba a ƙidaya lokaci. Danna "Babban hoto" don nuna hoto kawai, don kowa a daki ya gani a talabijin.
howTo: Ku kalli hoton tare.
Karanta layin da ke ƙasansa da babbar murya idan kana so.
Danna "Hoto na gaba" ko "Hoto na baya" idan ka shirya.
Danna "Babban hoto" don nuna hoto kawai, da "Nuna komai" don dawo da sauran.
Ka tsaya duk lokacin da ka so da "An gama yanzu".
tips: Bari mutum ya zaɓi lokacin da zai ci gaba: ka jira ya kalla, sannan ka danna Gaba.
Ga rukuni, yi amfani da "Babban hoto" a talabijin ko babban allo, kuma ku zauna inda kowa zai iya gani.
Babu hanya ɗaya daidai ta kallon hoto. Kawai magana a kansa aiki ne cikakke.

faq.q: Akwai agogo ko maki?
faq.a: A'a. Babu agogo, maki, ƙidayar motsi ko asara. Za ka iya tsayawa a kowane lokaci, kuma tsayawa a tsakiya hanya ce mai kyau ta kammalawa.

faq.q: Yana yin sauti ko motsi?
faq.a: A'a. Babu sauti, kuma babu abin da ke motsi, dushewa ko canzawa da kansa. Hoto yana canzawa ne kawai idan ka danna maballi.

faq.q: Gibi kitab ya?
faq.a: A'a. Wannan hoto ne da ake kallo tare a kan allo. Hoton da kuke so ko katin gaisuwa a kan teburi yana yin irin wannan.

faq.q: Kyauta ne, kuma ana buƙatar yin rajista?
faq.a: Eh, kyauta ne, kuma babu asusu, rajista ko sauke fayil. Yana aiki a mai binciken yanar gizo a waya, kwamfutar hannu ko kwamfuta.

color-wash.name: Wanke da launi
color-wash.seoTitle: Wanke da Launi: Launi Mai Laushi a Shafi
color-wash.h1: Wanke da Launi: Shafa Launi Mai Laushi a Shafi
color-wash.description: Buroshi mai laushi yana shafa faɗaɗɗun launuka masu haske a shafi ɗaya, cikin launuka huɗu da girman buroshi biyu. Babu ƙarshe, babu maki, babu agogo. Kyauta ne a yi wasa, ba tare da asusu ba.
color-wash.short: Shafa launuka masu laushi a shafi, a hankalinku.
color-wash.players: Shi kaɗai, ko mutum 2 suna zaune gefe da gefe
color-wash.intro: Shafi ɗaya da buroshi mai laushi ɗaya. Zaɓi launi da girman buroshi, sannan ja a shafin don shafa launi. Shafin ba shi da ƙarshe: babu abin da za a gama, babu hoton da za a yi daidai, babu maki. Shafa launuka kamar yadda kuke so, ko ajiye buroshin ku kawai ku kalla. Shafi sabo yana share komai, kuma "Mayar da shi" yana dawo da shi.
howTo: Zaɓi launi. Kowane launi yana da sunansa a rubuce.
Zaɓi Faɗi ko Faɗi sosai. Faɗi sosai yana rufe ƙarin shafi a kowane shafa.
Ja a shafin da yatsa, linzamin kwamfuta ko alƙalami don shafa launi.
Ko kuma yi amfani da maɓallan kibiya don motsa zoben buroshi, da maɓallin Space don sanya buroshi ƙasa ko ɗaga shi.
Danna "Shafi sabo" don share shafin, sannan "Mayar da shi" idan kuna son shafa baya.
tips: Bari ɗayan mutum ya zaɓi launin shafa na gaba, kuma ku yi magana game da launuka yayin da suke shiga.
Faɗi sosai ya fi sauƙin jagoranta idan hannu yana girgiza, domin buroshin ba ya buƙatar zama daidai.
Babu hanya guda daidai ta zane. Ku tsaya duk lokacin da kuke so, ko danna "An gama yanzu".

faq.q: Akwai ƙarshe, maki ko agogo?
faq.a: A'a. Shafin ba shi da ƙarshe. Babu abin da ake gamawa, ƙidaya, auna lokaci ko ba da maki, kuma babu saƙo da zai nemi ku yi ƙari.

faq.q: Ana adana shafin ko aika shi?
faq.a: A'a. Ba a adana, buga ko aika komai ko'ina. Shafa launukan suna nan a wannan shafi har sai kun bar shi.

faq.q: Zan iya amfani da wannan ba tare da linzamin kwamfuta ko allon taɓawa ba?
faq.a: Eh. Idan shafin yana kan mai da hankali, maɓallan kibiya suna motsa zoben buroshi, kuma maɓallin Space yana sanya buroshi ƙasa ko ya ɗaga shi. Allon yana cewa "Buroshi ƙasa" ko "Buroshi sama" duk lokacin da aka yi haka.

faq.q: Akwai sigar takarda?
faq.a: A'a. Fenti mai ruwa a takarda shi ne ra'ayi iri ɗaya, buroshi mai ruwa da launi ɗaya a lokaci guda, don haka aiki ne daban da za a gwada a teburi.

faq.q: Waɗanne launuka ne?
faq.a: Rawaya, lemu, kore da shunayya, launuka huɗu iri ɗaya da ake amfani da su a sauran wasannin hotunanmu. Kowane yana da sunansa a rubuce, kuma sunan yana bayyana kusa da zaɓin.

faq.q: Kyauta ne, kuma ana buƙatar yin rajista?
faq.a: Eh, kyauta ne, kuma babu asusu, rajista ko sauke fayil. Yana aiki a mai binciken yanar gizo a waya, kwamfutar hannu ko kwamfuta.
